sloka: एवम् एकान्त संपृक्तौ ततः तौ नर वानरौ ।उभौ अन्योन्य सदृशम् सुख दुःखम् अभाष्ताम् ॥४-७-२४॥
transliteration: evam ekānta saṁpṛktau tataḥ tau nara vānarau ।ubhau anyonya sadṛśam sukha duḥkham abhāṣtām ॥4-7-24॥

translations.english: Man and monkey then met privately and shared the weal and woe of one another.
